card.name: Muscle injury terms and bowel-prep doses
card.fires_on: Partway through muscle-injury words such as myopathy, myositis and rhabdomyolysis, mostly in statin or fibrate warnings. It also fires on the word "of" in "Each dose consists of" in bowel-prep labels.

modes.label: Muscle injury words
modes.description: The start or middle of myopathy, myositis or rhabdomyolysis, and sometimes metformin, in statin and fibrate text.

modes.label: Dose consists of
modes.description: The word "of" after "Each dose consists" in colonoscopy prep kit directions.
modes.example: morning of the colonoscopy. Each dose consists<< of>> one bottle of sodium sulfate, potassium sulfate

card.writes: It seems to help the model finish the rest of long muscle-injury words, but the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of words like myopathy and rhabdomyolysis in statin warnings, and on "consists of" in bowel-prep dosing.
